relevance_note: Post-mortem study of one individual with SSADH deficiency with individual-level clinical detail: "obtained from a 37 y.o. male patient with succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency (SSADHD)".
method_note: Single-patient post-mortem study; written by hand (small script only assembled the JSON). No ALDH5A1 variant, zygosity or molecular test result is printed or tied to the patient (the Introduction mentions molecular analysis only in general), so the variants table is empty; the field name reports_individuals_with_tnfaip3_variant is set true because the person has a stated SSADHD diagnosis with individual-level detail. Same patient previously reported (Haan et al 1985; Kirby et al 2020). Clinical features come from the Materials and Methods summary; 'global developmental delays' was not mapped to the intellectual disability checklist item. EEG/MRI/CT follow-up was 'not undertaken', so those checklist items are not reported. Histopathology (reactive astrogliosis, increased white matter neurons) recorded as features; regional phospholipid/plasmalogen mass changes (Tables 1-6) and gene-expression dysregulation (Tables 7-8) are tissue-level research measurements and were not recorded as phenotypic features. Epilepsy, autism and thyroid findings are described as part of the history 'Throughout adolescence and into adulthood (2^nd–3^rd decades of life)'; this is not clearly an onset age, so onset was left null. Age 37 is age at death (recorded as last evaluation and deceased age). The paper contains the typo 'hee expired', quoted verbatim. No contradictions found.
